subject: Media Literacy
title: The Internet of Things and Always-On Listening
description: Learn The Internet of Things and Always-On Listening in one minute.

hook.text: A couple discussed dog food near their Alexa. Dog food ads appeared within hours. Coincidence or surveillance?

buildup.text: Smart speakers, TVs, watches, and home devices create an 'Internet of Things' — always connected, always collecting.

discovery.text: These devices collect voice data, usage patterns, and environmental information — often shared with third parties.

twist.text: Companies say devices only listen for wake words. But recordings show they activate thousands of times without being triggered.

climax.text: Every smart device is a data collector. The 'smart' means it learns about you, not just that it's clever.

punchline.text: The device listens to serve you. It also listens to learn you.

quiz.question: What privacy concern do smart home devices raise?
options: They collect voice data and usage patterns, often shared with third parties
